name: Microscope rocks
description: Thin sections of rock under a polarising microscope: shattered mosaics of crystals in electric interference colours, cracks and grain boundaries.
light: transmitted polarised light, glowing colours against black extinction
composition: all-over, edge to edge, no horizon; a mosaic of grains, sometimes one large crystal as focus
camera_or_medium: photomicrograph of a petrographic thin section, crossed polarisers
texture_detail: sharp crystal edges, fine cleavage lines, rainbow interference bands, dark cracks
subjects: a mosaic of blue and orange crystals
one large zoned crystal in a dark field
